questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Birds navigate primarily using visual landmarks
European robins can detect extremely weak magnetic fields
Young birds rely primarily on learning from adult birds
Birds use only their magnetic sense for navigation
Bar-tailed godwits rest several times during migration
questions.correctAnswer: European robins can detect extremely weak magnetic fields
questions.explanation: Text 1 states that Research from Oxford University demonstrated that European robins can perceive magnetic fields as weak as 0.005% of Earth's strength.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?

questions.correctAnswer: Phoenix experiences temperature differences up to 6\textdegree\text{C} compared to nearby desert areas
questions.explanation: Text 2 mentions Phoenix, Arizona demonstrates an extreme case, with summer evening temperatures up to 6°C higher than nearby desert areas.

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Fingerprint patterns change significantly throughout a person's life
Loop patterns occur in approximately 60-65% of fingerprints
The average fingerprint contains about 500 minutiae
Fingerprints can only be recovered from non-porous surfaces
DNA evidence has completely replaced fingerprint analysis
questions.correctAnswer: Loop patterns occur in approximately 60-65% of fingerprints
questions.explanation: Text 5 indicates that these patterns fall into three main categories: arches (occurring in about 5% of fingerprints), loops (60-65%), and whorls (30-35%).

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the text is TRUE?
options: Fingerprint patterns form randomly with no genetic influence
Most fingerprints fall into the whorl pattern category
Vacuum metal deposition can detect fingerprints on fabric
India's Aadhaar system contains approximately 500 million fingerprint records
Ultrasonic sensors primarily detect chemical composition of fingerprints
questions.correctAnswer: Vacuum metal deposition can detect fingerprints on fabric
questions.explanation: Text 5 states that latent fingerprints from crime scenes can now be analyzed using vacuum metal deposition techniques that detect residues on challenging surfaces like fabric and paper.
